retrievalProfile.description: A centered female portrait framed by vertical shimmering beaded curtains with a warm golden glow and soft-focus Y2K typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a female figure centered against a dense backdrop of vertical, shimmering gold and crystal beaded curtains. The lighting is warm and diffused, creating a 'glamour glow' effect with numerous specular highlights (sparkles) scattered across the beads and hair. The subject wears earth-toned, textured clothing typical of late 90s/early 2000s pop fashion.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between two primary text blocks
Vertical lines of beads contrasting with the organic curves of the subject
Warm golden background tones harmonizing with the subject's hair and skin
Soft-focus glow effect unifying the foreground and background
coreInvariants: Vertical beaded curtain backdrop with high-specular highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, occupying the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright specular highlights on the beaded curtain.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the central face outward to the large flanking text, then down to the smaller secondary text in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with shimmering beads and bokeh.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Gold and Amber (Background and Highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown and Bronze (Clothing and Shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value with moderate saturation; the image feels bright and 'washed' in light.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase primary display text with rounded terminals
Condensed, high-contrast serif for secondary text
Heavy outer glow/halo effect on all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dot on 'i' often integrated into the glow

composition.overlap: Behind or slightly over subject's arms

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a soft, rounded geometric display face and a sharp, condensed serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, rounded geometric lowercase aesthetic
Matches the high-contrast serif secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium portrait of a woman with blonde wavy hair in a brown top, centered against a dense background of vertical gold beaded curtains with heavy shimmering bokeh and lens flares.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase rounded sans-serif text flanking the subject at chest height with a soft purple outer glow. Add condensed serif text in the bottom right corner with a subtle shadow.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a visible purple/magenta glow?
Are there vertical beaded lines in the background?
Is the lighting warm and golden?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'glamour glow' diffusion across the entire frame
Verify text is split and centered around the subject
Check for starburst effects on highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Vertical Beaded Backdrop + Golden Glow + Glowing Lowercase Typography
